decisions.decision: The water commissioners will continue their discussions with Lancaster and have applied to the DEP to increase the amount allowed under the permit; they will check back with the Board in early 2019 on progress.
decisions.quote: the water commissioners will continue their discussions with lancaster and have applied to the dep to increase the amount allowed under the permit.

budget_items.topic: Projected income from IMA sale of water to Lancaster
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Esposito said potential income to the water district from the agreement could eventually reach a stated annual amount, based on Lancaster's usage chart.
budget_items.quote: potential income for the water district from this agreement could eventually be $350,000 per year.

budget_items.topic: Funding the water district capital improvement plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The district is considering selling water to Lancaster to fund its capital improvement plan, the alternative being higher rates for Lunenburg users; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the only other option to fund it would be to raise rates for lunenburg water users

budget_items.topic: Pipe replacement during MassDOT Route 2A bridge work
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Water district would pay for a water pipe replaced during the MassDOT bridge deck work; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: replace a water pipe while working there if the water district pays for the pipe.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ebersole stated the district should not pay any money to construct or maintain in Lancaster, and water rates to Lancaster should be at a premium plus maintenance costs; no figures printed.
